aiTitle: Sunday Reset: Bongo's Vet and Nomsa's Schedule

message.content: Morning. I need to sort a few things out before the week starts. First, please send a quick message to Sipho reminding him to pick up the dry kibble for Bongo on his way home from the office. He promised he would last night.

content.text: Sure thing. I've drafted a message for Sipho: "Hey, please remember to grab Bongo's dry kibble on your way home. Love you!" Shall I send it now?

message.content: Yes, send it. Also, I need to update my calendar. I was supposed to stick with Sarah Jenkins for my Pilates classes, but I've changed my mind. I'm going back to Nomsa Khumalo. I made this decision on Monday 6 April, so please update my recurring booking for the Thursday evening slot starting next week.

content.text: I've cancelled the bookings with Sarah Jenkins and scheduled your Thursday evening Pilates class with Nomsa Khumalo, effective next week. I've noted the change was made on Monday 6 April in your records. Is there anything else regarding your schedule?

message.content: Just one more thing. I got an email about my gear insurance. The premium has gone up. It's now 950 ZAR. It used to be 800 ZAR. I saw this on Saturday 11 April. Please add this new rate to my monthly expenses tracker and flag it so I can review if I need to adjust my budget.

content.text: I've updated your gear insurance premium to 950 ZAR in your expense tracker, noting the change occurred on Saturday 11 April. I've also flagged it for your review. Would you like me to draft a comparison summary of your previous versus current insurance costs?

message.content: No, that's fine. Thanks for handling that.
